## Author checklist
- [ ] PR is small and focused (ideally < 400 lines)
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:` ...)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they pass locally
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or PII committed
- [ ] Logging, metrics, and alerts added for new code paths
- [ ] Docs / README / changelog updated
- [ ] Backward compatible (API contracts, config, schemas)
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff
